label: no
controls_available: Entry stage: one fixed simplified decision-proxy button for the generated manage action; the moving gateway card is non-interactive in simplified mode.
Preferences stage: one visible drawer with previous/next navigation controls; with one drawer, both navigation actions are ineffective.
Preferences stage: each of three purpose rows exposes explicit SET NO and SET YES buttons; the displayed switch rail is not interactive in simplified mode.
Preferences stage: REVIEW CURRENT CHOICES advances to final review.
Final stage: one fixed simplified decision-proxy button for the generated commit action; there are no reset traps or linked controls.

autonomous_processes.period: While an entry or final gateway is displayed
autonomous_processes.change: A requestAnimationFrame loop repeatedly updates the visible packet timer and recomputes gateway positions.
autonomous_processes.effect: Because moving_gateways is false, currentPhase is constant and the gateway positions remain fixed; only the wall-clock readout changes.

autonomous_processes.period: While the preferences ledger is displayed
autonomous_processes.change: There is no autonomous task-state mutation.
autonomous_processes.effect: Purpose states change only from SET NO/SET YES event handlers, and this configuration has no reset traps or links.

grouped_control_modes.description: One generated option with the manage action opens the ledger.
SET NO or SET YES controls each of the three purpose rows.
Previous/next both resolve to the only drawer and produce no state change.
Review records the transition from preferences to final review.
One generated option with the commit action submits the current choices.

clause_i.reason: An observation-free policy can follow a fixed action schedule: choose the sole manage proxy, set each of the three purposes to NO (idempotently when already NO), review, and choose the sole commit proxy. Level 1 has no inverted purpose statements, so the optimal direction does not depend on the current screenshot or recent visual history.

clause_ii.reason: A bounded screenshot window is sufficient to select every action: the fixed proxies and the visible three-row ledger expose the available controls and current answers. The window is sufficient but unnecessary because no outcome-relevant state evolves autonomously.

clause_iii.reason: No autonomous non-clock task-state evolution makes an available action unavailable or less effective. The only autonomous update is the packet timer; stationary gateway geometry is unchanged, purpose state changes require an agent event, and waiting changes no action value apart from the excluded loss of remaining deadline.

common_visible_process: There is no common visible autonomous process witnessing clauses (i)-(iii). The requestAnimationFrame timer update is visible but unrelated to the outcome, while the gateway and ledger state remain unchanged between actions.

pre_run.reason: The exact configuration has no autonomous outcome phase: all outcome-relevant transitions are synchronous responses to visible controls, so the pre-run threshold does not apply. The mathematical classification is already No.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 1 sets three purposes, zero negative-purpose statements, one drawer, one entry option, one final option, zero reset traps, zero links, stationary gateways, and zero orbit speed.
Simplified mode uses fixed gateway proxies and explicit answer buttons; the configured observation window is 720 ms with five frames.
Generated positive purposes receive target false, while only negative-purpose statements receive target true; level 1 therefore makes every target NO.
Each gateway always contains one correct action and fills the remaining option slots with decoys; with one option, the entry and final actions are fixed manage and commit choices.
The phase advances with elapsed time only when moving_gateways is true; the animation loop otherwise recomputes fixed positions while updating the visible packet timer.
The gateway is marked stationary when movement is disabled, and simplified mode supplies the fixed consent proxy while rendering the orbit cards.
The preferences view renders the current drawer and purpose answers; simplified mode adds SET NO/SET YES buttons and no reset markup exists when the reset list is empty.
Purpose, drawer, review, and gateway state transitions are called by input event handlers; there is no autonomous purpose-state update.
Simplified mode disables pointer interaction on orbit cards, drawer tabs, and physical switch rails while exposing the proxy buttons.

The grader binds the submitted interaction source to simplified controls, replays only submitted events, checks elapsed time only for ordering and the 180-second bound, and requires committed final state plus all target states and links.
The reference solver derives targets from negative wording, fixes all visible purposes, then reviews and commits; it contains no timing-dependent task action.
